name: Salesforce Service Cloud (Agentforce Service)
oneLiner: Salesforce's customer service platform, now branded Agentforce Service, combining case management across channels with CRM data and AI agents.
bestFor: Large, multi-location or enterprise brands that already run Salesforce and need a configurable, CRM-connected service desk with AI agents.

updates.text: Salesforce launched Agentforce Contact Center at Enterprise Connect 2026: a native contact center add-on for Agentforce Service (formerly Service Cloud) combining voice, digital channels, CRM data and AI agents, generally available in the US and Canada.
Winter '26 release added new Agentforce features across service products.

features: Agent console with case management across phone, email, chat, messaging and social
Agentforce AI agents that answer customers around the clock and hand off to people
AI assistance for agents: reply drafting, case summaries and classification
Native contact center and voice (Agentforce Contact Center add-on)
Self-service help center and knowledge base
Entitlements and SLA management, routing and omni-channel queues
Reporting and dashboards on service performance

pricing.text: Starter Suite from $25/user/month (billed annually); higher editions and the Agentforce for Service add-on ($125/user/month, billed annually) or per-conversation pricing from $2 cost more.

notes: Service Cloud has been rebranded Agentforce Service (third-party and Salesforce press reporting; Salesforce says SKUs and functionality are unchanged). salesforce.com could not be fetched; pricing from search snippets of the pricing page. Third-party edition prices (Pro $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350) not verified on salesforce.com, so left out. Finnair and Pandora come from Salesforce's customer stories hub snippets.
